name: Fluffkin (live) + X-Holloh + Zandria
description: Multiverse Events presents Cosmic Bloom, featuring performances by Fluffkin (live), X-Holloh, and Zandria at Era uma vez no Porto.
longDescription:
Multiverse Events presents Cosmic Bloom at Era uma vez no Porto, located at Rua da Madeira, 126. The night features Fluffkin performing live, alongside sets by X-Holloh and Zandria.

The event takes place on 21 November 2026, starting at 23:59. Entry is restricted to attendees aged 18 and over.
